citation: Meyers, C., Molefe, A., Dhillon, S., & Zhu, B. (2015). The Impact of eMINTS Professional Development on Middle School Teacher Instruction and Student Achievement: Year 3 Report. Washington, DC: American Institutes for Research. [Published as: Meyers, C. V., Molefe, A., Brandt, W. C., Zhu, B., & Dhillon, S. (2016). Impact Results of the eMINTS Professional Development Validation Study. Educational Evaluation and Policy Analysis, 38(3), 455-476. https://doi.org/10.3102/0162373716638446]
report_number: i3 Validation grant U396B100038; AIR report 15-1527; WWC Study 81457/87694; EEPA 38(3):455-476
design: Cluster-randomized RCT (3-year i3 validation); randomization unit = school; 60 high-poverty rural Missouri middle schools randomized 20/20/20 to eMINTS Comprehensive (2-yr PD), eMINTS+Intel (eMINTS + 3rd-year Intel Teach PD), or business-as-usual control. Two-level HLM (students nested in schools), pretest- and covariate-adjusted, block-pooled Hedges's g. Year 3 (2013-14) end-of-treatment wave. Subjects: mathematics and communication arts (MAP state test). Grades 7-8. Year 3 MAP-math analytic sample: 59 schools (20 eMINTS+Intel, 20 eMINTS, 19 control), 3,072 students; MAP-communication-arts analytic sample: 59 schools (20/20/19), 3,295 students.
problems: Included study (row 78) is the EEPA 2016 journal article (DOI 10.3102/0162373716638446), which is closed/paywalled (Unpaywall & OpenAlex: oa_status closed, no OA copy). Effect sizes here are extracted from the openly available, identical underlying RCT reported in the AIR Year 3 final report (Meyers, Molefe, Dhillon & Zhu, April 2015), the i3-funded final evaluation, retrieved via the Internet Archive raw-content endpoint of the developer/funder-hosted PDF (eMINTS National Center / AIR). All four student-achievement contrasts come from Table 4.1 (PDF p.73-74; report p.70-71). Both eMINTS arms are TPD-vs-business-as-usual. The eMINTS+Intel-vs-eMINTS contrasts (TPD-vs-TPD), 21st century skills, student engagement, and all teacher-practice outcomes are excluded per spec. No ICC is reported anywhere in the report; effect sizes are model-based Hedges's g from a two-level HLM that already accounts for clustering, so cluster_adjusted=true and icc=null (NOT guessed). g equals the report's reported block-pooled Hedges's g effect size; g_se is the model impact standard error scaled to the g metric (impact estimate and effect size are on the same standardized z-score SD metric, so g_se is effectively the reported SE).

effect_sizes.arm_label: eMINTS Comprehensive (2-yr PD) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported block-pooled Hedges's g from two-level HLM (students nested in schools), standardized on within-block standardized MAP z-score metric (scores z-standardized by year/grade/subject/block); g_se = model impact SE scaled to g metric (0.063 * 0.128/0.129).
effect_sizes.notes: Confirmatory RQ1 outcome. Mean values are regression-adjusted standardized z-scores; pooled posttest SD not separately reported (outcome pre-standardized to SD=1 metric). Statistically significant positive (p=0.040). Schools: 20 eMINTS + 19 control = 39 clusters.

effect_sizes.arm_label: eMINTS+Intel (eMINTS + 3rd-yr Intel Teach PD) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported block-pooled Hedges's g from two-level HLM (students nested in schools), standardized on within-block standardized MAP z-score metric; g_se = model impact SE scaled to g metric (0.065 * 0.178/0.168).
effect_sizes.notes: Confirmatory RQ1 outcome. Second TPD arm. Statistically significant positive (p=0.009). Schools: 20 eMINTS+Intel + 19 control = 39 clusters.

effect_sizes.arm_label: eMINTS Comprehensive (2-yr PD) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported block-pooled Hedges's g from two-level HLM (students nested in schools), standardized on within-block standardized MAP z-score metric; g_se = model impact SE on g metric (0.050).
effect_sizes.notes: Confirmatory RQ1 outcome (communication arts = ELA/literacy -> Reading). Not statistically significant (p=0.484), negative point estimate. Schools: 20 eMINTS + 19 control = 39 clusters.

effect_sizes.arm_label: eMINTS+Intel (eMINTS + 3rd-yr Intel Teach PD) vs business-as-usual control
effect_sizes.g_method: Reported block-pooled Hedges's g from two-level HLM (students nested in schools), standardized on within-block standardized MAP z-score metric; g_se = model impact SE scaled to g metric (0.051 * 0.077/0.076).
effect_sizes.notes: Confirmatory RQ1 outcome (communication arts -> Reading). Second TPD arm. Not statistically significant (p=0.137), negative point estimate. Schools: 20 eMINTS+Intel + 19 control = 39 clusters.
